newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Feb unemployment rises to 4.316 million.
newsitem.headline: German Feb unemployment rises to 4.316 million.

text.p: German unemployment rose to a seasonally adjusted 4.316 million in February, an increase of 5,000, the Federal Labour Office said on Thursday.
The unemployment rate, which is based on unadjusted data, was unchanged from January at 12.2 percent.
The unadjusted total number of unemployed was 4.672 million, up from 4.658 million in January.

In January, a sharp rise of 145,000 in the seasonally adjusted total fueled speculation Germany would fail to narrow its budget gap this year and miss the deficit target for the single European currency.
Finance Minister Theo Waigel said late Wednesday Germany must achieve a labour market turnaround by summer to meet the Maastricht convergence criteria.
Labour Office President Bernhard Jagoda told a news conference on Thursday the worst of Germany's jobs crisis may now be over since the rise in unemployment slowed sharply in February.
But he added that the construction sector remains very weak, and that the economy provided no stimulus for jobs creation in February.

In west Germany, the adjusted number of unemployed fell by 4,000 to 3.018 million in February. The unemployment rate was unchanged at 10.6 percent.In east Germany, the adjusted number of unemployed rose by 9,000 to 1.298 million. The unemployment rate was 18.9 percent, up from 18.7 percent.
